name: Art Exhibition Assistance in the State
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹25,000/- or actual expenses incurred (whichever is less) for organizing an art exhibition.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have received formal art education or should have conducted a previous individual or group art exhibition. 1. The applicant should organize an exhibition within Gujarat. 1. The applicant should exhibit a minimum of 30 artworks in the sponsored exhibition.
